title: CAGR for 1Y / 3Y / 5Y / since inception
description: Performance must be advertised in terms of CAGR for at least the past 1 year, 3 years, 5 years, and since inception.

pass.note: All four periods shown as CAGR.

fail.content: Look at our stellar 1-year return of 12.4%!

title: Point-to-point return on ₹10,000
description: Point-to-point returns on a standard investment of Rs. 10,000 must also be provided alongside CAGR.

pass.content: CAGR 1Y 12.4%; value of ₹10,000 invested 1 year ago: ₹11,240.

fail.note: CAGR present but no ₹10,000 point-to-point value.

title: Plan stated + different-expense-structure footnote
description: It must be specifically mentioned whether the performance shown is of the Direct or Regular plan, along with a footnote stating that different plans have a different expense structure.

pass.content: Performance shown is for the Direct Plan - Growth option. Different plans have a different expense structure.
pass.note: Plan named and expense-structure footnote present.

fail.note: Neither plan nor expense-structure footnote stated.

title: Data as of last day of preceding month-end
description: Performance information must be based on the period computed from the last day of the month-end preceding the date of the advertisement.

pass.note: Month-end dating (verify it precedes the ad date).

fail.note: Mid-month 'as on' date, not a month-end.

title: Fund-manager-change footnote
description: If the scheme has not been managed by the same fund manager for the full period of the performance shown, that must be disclosed in a footnote.

pass.content: Note: the fund manager changed on 1 April 2025; performance prior to that date reflects the previous manager.

fail.content: 5Y CAGR 13.8% under our fund manager's expert stewardship.
fail.note: Attributes full-period performance to current FM with no tenure footnote — verify FM tenure.

title: Short-track-record performance limits
description: Where the scheme has been in existence for less than six months, past performance must not be provided; if in existence for more than six months but less than one year, only the simple annualised growth rate (past 6 months and since inception) may be shown.

pass.content: The scheme was launched 8 months ago; simple annualised return since inception is shown.
pass.note: 6–12 month scheme uses simple annualised return.

fail.content: Launched just 3 months ago and already up 5% — see the returns!
fail.note: Past performance shown for a sub-6-month scheme.

title: Scheme and benchmark risk-o-meter when performance shown
description: When the performance of a scheme or benchmark is displayed, the risk-o-meter of both the scheme and the benchmark must be given.
source_clause: Internal Performance checklist item 12; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20 (product labelling)

pass.content: Performance table alongside the scheme risk-o-meter and the benchmark risk-o-meter.

fail.content: Performance vs benchmark shown, with only the scheme risk-o-meter.

title: SIP performance requires lumpsum, cash-flow detail, and XIRR note
description: When SIP performance is shown, the corresponding scheme lumpsum performance must also be shown, the SIP instalment periodicity must be stated, and an XIRR note must be given for the SIP returns.
source_clause: Internal Performance checklist items 16-17; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

pass.content: SIP returns (XIRR): 14.1% — ₹1,000 invested on the first business day of every month. Corresponding lumpsum CAGR: 13.8%. Returns computed using the XIRR method.

fail.content: Your SIP would have earned 14.1% returns!
fail.note: SIP return only; no lumpsum, periodicity, or XIRR note.

title: Other schemes managed by the same fund manager
description: When a scheme's performance is advertised, performance of the other schemes managed by the same fund manager must be included (1Y/3Y/5Y CAGR with benchmarks); if the fund manager manages more than six schemes, disclose the total number and the top-3 and bottom-3 schemes.

pass.content: Performance of other schemes managed by the fund manager (1Y/3Y/5Y CAGR with benchmarks); as the manager runs more than six schemes, the total count and top-3 and bottom-3 schemes are disclosed (link provided).

fail.content: A single scheme's 1/3/5Y performance, with no reference to the manager's other schemes.

title: IDCW payout disclosures
description: While advertising IDCW payouts, the IDCW declared or paid must be shown in rupees per unit along with the face value and the prevailing NAV at declaration; and immediately below any pay-out figure it must be stated that the NAV falls to the extent of the payout and statutory levy.

pass.content: IDCW declared: ₹0.50 per unit (face value ₹10; NAV ₹18.20 at declaration). Note: pursuant to the payout, the NAV of the scheme falls to the extent of the payout and statutory levy (if applicable).
pass.note: IDCW in ₹/unit with face value, NAV, and the NAV-fall note.

fail.content: Enjoy a 5% IDCW payout from our fund!
fail.note: IDCW as a percentage only; no ₹/unit, face value, NAV, or NAV-fall note.

title: Short-horizon fund annualised yields
description: For Overnight, Liquid, and Money Market funds, performance may be advertised by simple annualisation of yields only if a figure is available for at least 7, 15, and 30 calendar days, and provided it does not present an unrealistic or misleading picture.

pass.note: 7/15/30-day simple annualised yields for a liquid fund.

fail.content: [AMC] Liquid Fund — annualised return of 7.0% (based on the last 3 days).
fail.note: Annualised from too short a window; 7/15/30-day basis not met.

title: Additional benchmark disclosure
description: Performance must also show the prescribed additional benchmark for the scheme category (e.g. Sensex/Nifty for equity, 1-year T-Bill for short-duration debt/arbitrage, 10-year GOI security for other debt), in INR and as CAGR, alongside the scheme benchmark.

pass.content: Equity scheme performance shown against its benchmark and the additional benchmark (Nifty 50 TRI), in CAGR and value of ₹10,000.

fail.content: Equity scheme performance shown against its own benchmark only.

title: Period-specific performance labelling
description: Any disclosure of quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly performance must pertain to the respective calendar quarter, half-year, or year only.

pass.note: Quarterly figure tied to the calendar quarter.

fail.content: Quarterly return: 4.1% (for a rolling 90-day window ending mid-month).
fail.note: Quarterly label not aligned to the calendar quarter.

title: Post-merger performance disclosure
description: Where performance is shown for a scheme that resulted from a merger, the correct surviving-scheme rule must be applied: weighted-average performance when both schemes had identical features, the retained scheme's performance when its features are retained, and no past performance when a new scheme emerges.

pass.content: Post-merger, the performance shown is that of the transferee scheme whose features are retained, with a note explaining the merger.

fail.content: After merging two schemes into a brand-new scheme, the pre-merger track record is presented as the new scheme's performance.
fail.note: Past performance shown for a newly emerged post-merger scheme.
